import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a pandas DataFrame from the given dataset
data = {
    "survived": [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    "pclass": [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    "sex": ["male", "female", "female", "female", "male"],
    "age": [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    "sibsp": [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    "parch": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    "fare": [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    "embarked": ["S", "C", "S", "S", "S"],
    "class": ["Third", "First", "Third", "First", "Third"],
    "who": ["man", "woman", "woman", "woman", "man"],
    "adult_male": [True, False, False, False, True],
    "deck": ["", "C", "", "S", ""],
    "embark_town": ["Southampton", "Cherbourg", "Southampton", "Southampton", "Southampton"],
    "alive": ["no", "yes", "yes", "yes", "no"],
    "alone": [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert categorical variables to numerical
df['sex'] = df['sex'].map({'male': 0, 'female': 1})
df['embarked'] = df['embarked'].map({'S': 0, 'C': 1})
df['class'] = df['class'].map({'Third': 0, 'First': 1})
df['who'] = df['who'].map({'man': 0, 'woman': 1})

# Visualize the dataset
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
sns.barplot(x="class", y="fare", data=df)
plt.title("Fare Distribution by Class")
plt.xlabel("Class")
plt.ylabel("Fare")
plt.savefig("output.png")
